Prerequisites: Chemist 16

Once per day, the chemist can brew an elixir of life. An elixir of life, when administered by the chemist who brewed it, restores life to a dead creature as per the spell Full Life, reviving 3 rounds after it was administered. Alternatively, the chemist himself may drink the elixir of life, after which point he is immediately targeted with a Full Life spell the next time he is killed, reviving 3 rounds after he died. Used in this manner, the effects of an elixir of life persist only for a number of days equal to the chemist's Intelligence modifier; if he does not die before that time expires, the effects of the elixir of life end.
